message:
Running command: cat > /tmp/a.s <<'EOF'
.intel_syntax noprefix
vaddps zmm0 {k1}, zmm2, zmm3
vaddps zmm0 {k1}{z}, zmm2, zmm3
vaddps zmm0 {k1}, zmm2, [rax]{1to16}
valignd zmm0 {k1}, zmm2, zmm3, 7
vcompresspd [rax] {k1}, zmm2
vpscatterdd [rax+zmm0*4] {k1}, zmm2
EOF
as --64 /tmp/a.s -o /tmp/a.o && objdump -d -Mintel /tmp/a.o && objcopy -O binary -j .text /tmp/a.o /tmp/a.bin && xxd -p /tmp/a.bin
